text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and D for gains, then buying them back at higher prices, taught me not to treat a realized gain as proof that selling was right; I should follow a plan based on each stock’s outlook.","Holding Stock E until a 37.2% loss taught me that avoiding the pain of admitting a mistake can make a loss worse; I should reassess weak holdings promptly using their prospects, not my average cost.","My account fell over the last three periods while I made no trades, so I should review portfolio risk and diversification regularly—but avoid trading merely to react to short-term moves."]}
